llamacpp._note: gguf_path + n_gpu_layers set during T5.5 prep once the GGUF is downloaded; n_gpu_layers tuned to what fits the 12 GB card. resident=true: weights live in VRAM (HBM-bound), unlike AirLLM's per-layer streaming.

cold_flush._note: Sysinternals RAMMap '-Et' empties the Windows Standby List (cached file pages); '-accepteula' makes it non-interactive. Needs Administrator. No freed-MB threshold: standby counts toward 'available' on Windows so the delta is ~0 even on a real flush (ADR 0001) — cold-ness is proven by the cold/warm timing delta.

roofline._note: Hierarchical-roofline ceilings for the documented box (D7). Memory-hierarchy diagonals (GB/s) + the silicon compute roof; bytes_per_weight maps each quant to its on-the-wire byte cost per parameter. Each value documented below; retrieved 2026-06-21.

sources.compute_and_hbm: RTX 3080 Ti — FP16 dense tensor 68.2 TFLOP/s (sparse 136.4), 912 GB/s GDDR6X 384-bit (gpupoet.com/gpu/learn/card/nvidia-geforce-rtx-3080-ti)
sources.nvme: PCIe Gen4 NVMe sequential read ~7.0 GB/s (tomshardware.com/features/ssd-benchmarks-hierarchy)
sources.bytes_per_weight: fp16=2B, int8=1B, nf4=0.5B (4 bits), q4_k_m≈0.56B (~4.5 bpw effective)
sources.os_overhead_gb: OS + Python + PyTorch baseline RSS reserved from the 32 GB before it can serve as page cache; ~5 GB is the conservative working figure for this box (so usable cache ≈ 27 GB)
